title: bars
description: Values side by side as bars, each a label and a value, with its unit after it when written: a bar with of is filled as far as its value goes of that whole and reads value / of, as how far a piece of work has gone; the others are shares of the largest value among them

of.description: The whole the value is of, no less than value

unit.description: Drawn after the value, such as items or %

tone.description: The bar's colour, accent when left out
